children: Health In Tech issued YA II PN a $3.0 million promissory note on November 2, 2026, under its existing standby equity purchase financing arrangement, receiving $2.85 million after a 5% purchase discount. The note matures February 18, 2028, bears 8.75% annual interest, and may be converted into Class A common stock subject to specified limits. The financing adds capital while allowing certain installment payments to be made with proceeds from stock sales under the SEPA.
: Promissory note under a standby equity purchase agreement
: Raise capital and provide financing flexibility
